title: Godot 4.6 crashes when mousing over on Blender Path in Editor Settings

### System information

Linux (PikaOS), OpenGL/Vulkan, Mesa 25.3.202512042

### Issue description

Godot 4.6 crashes when mousing over Blender Path in Settings from Project List.

- Tried with Latest Stable MESA drivers as well as with MESA experimental, behaviour is the same.
- Tried forcing rendering-driver to vulkan, still crashes.
- Not sure why it randomly decides to pick OpenGL or Vulkan.

### Steps to reproduce

## Steps in 4.6
1 Open Godot
2 Navigate to Editor Settings, via settings on project list
3 Click on "Edit All Settings"
4 Go to FileSystem -> Import 
5 Mouse over the Label "Blender Path"
  - in 4.6, Godot crashes

For both, if you open a project and navigate to editor settings to same "blender path" location, no crash occurs.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No project is required to crash in 4.6.

To make it work you can open a basic empty project with forward+ renderer.
